installCommand: echo 'no npm install needed — Flutter manages its own deps'
buildCommand: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 _flutter_sdk && export PATH="$PATH:$(pwd)/_flutter_sdk/bin" && flutter config --enable-web && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --pwa-strategy=none --dart-define=API_BASE_URL=${API_BASE_URL:-https://banking-system-zhtb.onrender.com/api}
